Home / Buffet
Great variety · fresh every day

Our buffet.

From starters and soups to meat, fish and vegetables, sushi, fruit, ice cream and desserts – enjoy a visit that suits your taste.

Variety at your own pace

Try as much as you like.

Our buffet brings together classic Chinese dishes, sushi, fresh vegetables, fish and meat dishes, and a generous dessert selection. Savoury, light, vegetarian or sweet – everyone can find a favourite.

We offer a varied selection and regularly replenish the hot dishes with freshly prepared food.

Typically on offer

  • Soups, spring rolls and salads
  • Beef, chicken, duck and pork
  • Fish, prawns and other seafood
  • A variety of vegetables and side dishes
  • Sushi and vegetarian options
  • Cakes, ice cream, fruit and other desserts
